summary: High-level public Kiyori product invariants that should survive upstream integrations and refactors.
constraints: Preserve downstream user-facing behavior semantically when taking upstream architecture or bug fixes.
Navigation, app-lock/security behavior, notifications, widgets, stable media-row geometry and media-details freshness are protected regression surfaces.
External or upstream metadata must not be interpreted as a stronger product guarantee than the source actually provides.
Do not reintroduce a Wear module unless the user explicitly changes scope.
